ctx.x: The White and the Black woman. The Black woman was subjected to all kinds of abuse. See, she could be raped, she could be seduced into giving her something, and she'd come up with a child. But generally, they'd never give up their children. See, they don't go too much for orphanage. Whatever the scandal in the family, if it's White man's child, she kept her child...
